name: com.woodsshin.simpleupnp
description: Simple UPNP makes it easy to add, delete and list UDP/TCP port mappings on UPnP Internet Gateway Devices (routers). It discovers gateways with SSDP, reads manufacturer / status / link information and talks to the WANIPConnection / WANPPPConnection services over SOAP. Pure C#, no native plugins, no external services.

samples.description: A single-script demo that shows gateway information, connection status and the port mapping table, and lets you add or remove mappings. Works in every render pipeline.

A scene with a UPNP Settings window built with Unity UI: Manufacturer, Device Status and Port Mapping tabs, like the window of the Unreal plugin. Open UpnpSettings.unity and press Play. Needs the Unity UI package (com.unity.ugui).
